subject: reasoning
question:
Select the figure form amomg the given option that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/967fe8d495a16bda7167c33c4effba3e942dfd57ba6e7a2fb3a2f44e0380b84b.png]
solution:
In the given figure we can observe the pattern:

 
• The diamond moves in clock wise direction and turns solid after every alternate step.
 
• The triangle moves in clock wise direction and it is following the diamond.
 
• The circle inside the triangle turns solid after every alternate step.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ebabe3910fa3ab0eebde7a58264e652340084abfc75fb411dd6339a44a006bd3.png] ​

**Next step:**

 
• As the last block shows the diamond downwards, it will appear upwards in the next step due to the clockwise motion and the triangle will not be solid because it was solid in the last step.
 
• The triangle will face upwards as it follows the movement of diamond.
 
• The circle will be solid because of it's alternate behavior.

So the pattern with the next step will be :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ebabe3910fa3ab0eebde7a58264e652340084abfc75fb411dd6339a44a006bd3.png] 

Hence **the correct answer is option 2)**
